programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio

programme.title: Supercars

We took a closer look at the 700 hp Model S P85D with two electric engines and examined Tesla's supercharging technology.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Mercedes‘ S-Class Coupe is a real masterpiece. The significantly sportier two-door version of the S-Class doesn’t just look really good, it could also succeed in attracting Bentley or even Rolls Royce customers. We explored what the S 63 AMG Coupe has to offer in comparison to the Bentley Continental and the Rolls Royce Wraith.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the Ghibli, the Italian sports car manufacturer Maserati advanced into a more affordable market segment in order to attract a new clientele. But the competition, namely the BMW 5 series, Mercedes-Benz' E-Class, the Audi A6 or Jaguar's XF model, is strong. In addition: taking the Maserati GranCabrio MC on a cruise through the Alps.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Aston Martin V12 Vantage S Roadster with its 6-litre V12 engine is probably the most amazing export from the UK. It's the British brand's highest-powered convertible of all time. Does it live up to the expectations? In addition: a mountain cruise from dawn to dusk with the Corvette C7 Convertible.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4 combined the best elements that Porsche could offer: the V6 Boxer engine from the 911 Carrera S, the chassis, brake system and aerodynamics from the GT3, and a six-gear transmission. In addition: the Audi R8 V10 plus, an even stronger, lighter and faster version of the original model.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Dawn Convertible
programme.desc: Almost silently, it glides through the night. In front of the driver 12 smoothly-running cylinders are at work, with a power reserve that seems inexhaustible. The Rolls Royce Dawn is a convertible for connoisseurs.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith
programme.desc: The Rolls Royce Wraith is different. It gives the traditional British brand a whole new dynamic.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Ernest drives the updated Audi S3 on road and track. Zee travels to China for a look at what’s to come from Omoda and Jaecoo and Juliet gets reacquainted with the Isuzu MU-X.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: The team helps a young Uber driver pick a reliable budget crossover, debates if a VW Polo service plan is worth it, and weighs keeping a trusted Fortuner vs a new Chinese SUV now.

programme.title: Garage Gold
programme.desc: A dazzling vintage car show hosted by the Studebaker Club in Pretoria, the finest collection of vintage vehicles at the George Car Show, and the upcoming contenders in our Garage Gold Concourse competition.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: We bring you highlights from the inaugural BMW M Fest. Car enthusiasts share how they use their vehicles for a multitude of good causes. Our final Drag Kings contender lines up at the Christmas tree. Sbu gives in to his competitive streak around the karting circuit and we meet a passionate Mini owner.

programme.title: Volkswagen Beutler Convertible
programme.desc: The Swiss car body manufacturer – „Beutler Brothers“ build the convertible and presented it at the Geneva Motor Show in 54 and won the Design Award "La Rose d'Or". Actually, a great success, which did not replicate in high sales numbers. Only three special convertibles were produced. This copy, which belongs to the "Autostadt" in Wolfsburg, is the last one that still exists.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi is the most glamorous race track of the Formula One. Khaled Qubaysi takes us for a spin on this exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the famous race track.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials

programme.desc: Stéphane Peterhansel is the most successful driver in the history of the Dakar Rally. With the German team X-Raid he won the 2012 and 2013 editions of this prestigious competition in a Mini Countryman.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: For more than a century man and machine have tried to tame the Pikes Peak mountain, where daredevils risk everything to be the fastest up the 20-kilometer road to the summit at 4,300 meters above sea level. We show you the highlights of the 2018 race.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Former World Rally champion Armin Schwarz is a legend behind the wheel. We accompanied him when he instructed other talented drivers in a Subaru WRX STI rally car in the snowy and icy, but also breathtaking landscape of Finland.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Tourist Trophy on the British Isle of Man is the most famous motorcycle race in the world. TT Sidecar champion Klaus Klaffenböck and racing expert Lenz Leberkern explore the fascination behind this exciting and iconic racing event.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: 1963, over 50 years ago, with the Quattroporte Maserati invented a new vehicle category, the sports sedan. This GTS model is already the 6th generation of this iconic car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Even in the world of super sports cars people get goose bumps if they hear the name Lamborghini. All over the world these fighting bulls from Italy are famous for their spectacular design and massive power. Wherever they’re spotted, the Huracan and the Aventador, two of the currently produced models, always receive lots of attention.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayenne Turbo and the Range Rover Supercharged are big, fast and have a lot of power, so that they could even take on sports cars. The interior of these cars feels like a luxurious living room. Also: with the Bentayga, Bentley presented the iconic brand's first SUV model. And, another luxury crossover SUV premiere: the Jaguar F-Pace.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Tushek TS600, a super sports car built in Austria, was limited to 33 units, extremely light and had a power/weight ratio that is on the level of GT3 racing cars. But the best thing about this racer made of titanium, carbon and aluminum was that it was street-legal. The Bentley Continental GT3-R special edition was also limited to 300 units whereas McLaren offered their 570S to all customers.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Almost every big car manufacturer has its own tuning company where regular models are awarded an improved performance and a sportier look. But there are customers who aim for even more exclusivity. The German company Performmaster upgraded the Mercedes C63 AMG S, chip tuning from the Racechip company gave the Porsche Macan Turbo even more bite and Kellener did their take on the BMW 640i.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: How do high performance super cars fare in a cold climate? Nissan's all-wheel monster GT-R had to prove its winter suitability and the new Porsche 911 with turbo engine was taken to its limits in Finnish Lapland. Also: the Mercedes-Benz S 500 plug-in hybrid.

programme.title: Porsche Cayman GT4
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4. Lighter, more powerful and faster than ever. Porsche shows what is possible with this vehicle, when fast lap times are in the focus of attention.

programme.title: Volvo XC60
programme.desc: The Swedish landscape is characterized by mountains, forests and lonely roads. Ideal for this off-roader. The Volvo XC60 scores with many safety features and a cool appearance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Do you want to feel like a race driver without being limited to a race track? If so, the British manufacturer Radical has the perfect solution for you. The company builds race cars with road approval. Their RXC is an extremely aggressive and agile racer. And the best thing about it is that it's street legal, but doesn´t feel like that at all.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: After its introduction the Audi RS6 was the benchmark when it came to extreme estate cars. The car's power and performance was already very impressive, but according to the Audi tuners that still wasn't enough. Their challenge was to improve something that was already great.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It's not always a car's pure power that makes driving through curves exciting. The Subaru BRZ with its low boxer engine and its well-balanced handling gives his driver a very good feeling for the road. The BMW 235i RS has a great rear wheel performance and the Porsche Cayman GTS with its mid-engine puts a smile on your face as soon as you put your foot on the accelerator.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: AMG GT R - The Beast of The Green Hell
programme.desc: In this special, we followed the promotion shoot for the Mercedes-AMG GT R in Thailand and at the famous Nurburgring Nordschleife race track, where Formula One world champion Lewis Hamilton showed why this super car bears the nickname "The Beast of the Green Hell".

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: How do you top the already in many ways superior iconic Porsche 911? - You come up with the GT3. - The Porsche 911 GT3 with its 475 hp engine is the ultimate melange of road suitability and race track compatibility. And the German brand's RS model is even more intense when it comes to power, performance and ultimate sports car feel.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What has been known in motorsports for ages is now used for road vehicles as well: lightweight construction. In many cases the magic word is carbon. The German manufacturer Roding created a car that even outshined the Porsche GT3 with an impressive power/weight ratio. British makes like the Caterham 620 R, Lotus Elise or Radical RXC also showed what's in play in regards to lightweight sports cars.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupe
programme.desc: The M6 Gran Coupe is the latest creation from BMW's M-works subdivision. The Bavarians show that driving this V8 powered car almost feels like flying, even with the whole family on board.
